takes.title: Walk with Narrow Steps
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts mid-step, continues with narrow alternating strides and relaxed arms, and turns to the side while still walking at the end.

takes.title: Expressive dance turn
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts in a still crossed stance, raises and sweeps the arms, turns through crossed steps and a lifted leg, then lowers the arms and steps to finish.

takes.sourceDescription: dance - sideways arabesque, turn step, folding arms
takes.title: Dance turn with sideways leg extension
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts upright, bends and turns with a raised leg and extended arms, folds the arms overhead, and finishes in a crossed stance.

takes.sourceDescription: dance - sideways arabesque, folding arms, bending back
takes.title: Sideways leg extension and back bend
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts with one arm raised, moves into a high sideways leg extension, turns and bends, then comes upright with arms raised and finishes standing.

takes.sourceDescription: dance - quasi-cou-de-pied, raised leg above hip-height, jete en tourant
takes.title: Raised-leg dance and turning leap
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts in a crossed stance, lifts and extends a leg, turns through several elevated and crossing steps with sweeping arms, and finishes in a wide stance.

takes.title: Open with a Cartwheel and Continue into Dance Turns
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts with arms raised, bends into an inverted hand-supported movement, recovers into turning dance steps and a leap, then finishes standing.

takes.sourceDescription: dance - small jetes, attitude/arabesque, shifted-axis pirouette, turn
takes.title: Dance with raised back leg and turns
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts in a crossed stance, steps into a rear leg extension, turns and leans back with sweeping arms, then finishes with one arm raised.

takes.sourceDescription: dance - rond de jambe in the air, jete, turn
takes.title: High leg extension and split leap
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts with arms out, steps into a high leg extension, swings the leg sideways and makes a split-like leap, then lands and walks out.

takes.sourceDescription: dance - glissade devant, glissade derriere, attitude/arabesque
takes.title: Crossed-step dance and rear leg balance
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts in a crossed stance, raises both arms, turns and extends one leg behind, then steps out with a raised arm.

takes.sourceDescription: dance - glissade devant, glissade derriere, attitude/arabesque
takes.title: Dance turn with rear leg balance
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts in a crossed stance, opens and raises the arms while turning, extends a leg behind in a balance, and finishes with crossed steps and lowered arms.

takes.sourceDescription: dance - arms held high, pointe tendue a terre, upper body rotation
takes.title: Crossed stance and raised-arm rotation
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts and pauses in a crossed stance, then raises an arm, opens both arms while rotating the upper body, and finishes with a sweeping arm gesture.

takes.title: Dance steps, leap, and turn
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts in a crossed stance, steps out with arms extended, lifts a leg and turns through a balance, then extends the arms and returns upright.

takes.title: One-leg balances and dance turns
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts standing, crosses the feet and lifts a bent leg into a balance with arms extended, then turns into a raised-back-leg pose and ends in a crossed stance.

takes.sourceDescription: dance - coupe dessous, jete en tourant
takes.title: Turning dance leaps and leg extension
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts with small crossing steps, performs two airborne split-like leaps separated by steps, then raises one leg with arms overhead and finishes turning.

takes.sourceDescription: dance - coupe dessous, grand jete en tourant
takes.title: Dance leap and high rear-leg balance
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts in a crossed stance, steps into a wide airborne leap, lands, then raises a leg high behind with arms overhead and settles upright.

takes.sourceDescription: dance - attitude/arabesque, jete en tourant, bending back
takes.title: Dance leap and back bend
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts with small steps and a pause, moves into a raised-back-leg leap with arms overhead, bends back with arms extended, and returns upright.

takes.sourceDescription: dance - attitude/arabesque, jete en tourant, bending back
takes.title: Dance turns, leap, and back bend
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts in a crossed stance, turns with one leg lifted and arms extended, leaps with the rear leg raised, then bends back and returns to standing.

takes.sourceDescription: dance - attitude/arabesque, jete en tourant, bending back
takes.title: Raised-leg dance turn and back bend
takes.actionDescription: The performer walks into a turn with one arm raised, extends the trailing leg while reaching overhead, and passes through a crossed stance and a back bend. They step out of the phrase at the end.
